theorems.name: Submission.imc_ae_tendsto_of_summable_lintegral
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MeasurableSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (E : Type) [NormedAddCommGroup E] [CompleteSpace E] (f : ℕ → X → E), (∀ n, AEStronglyMeasurable (f n) μ) → (∑' n, ∫⁻ x, ‖f (n + 1) x - f n x‖ₑ ∂μ) ≠ ∞ → ∃ g : X → E, AEStronglyMeasurable g μ ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, Tendsto (fun n => f n x) atTop (𝓝 (g x))) ∧ Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ x, ‖f n x - g x‖ₑ ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
